definition: לֶ֫קַח noun masculine Prov 4:2 learning, teaching ( concrete; probably what is received ); — ׳ ל absolute Isa 29:24 + 5 t.; suffix לִקְחִי Deut 32:3 ; Job 11:4 לִקְחָהּ Prov 7:21 — 1. instruction , subjective, as personal acquirement; יִלְמְדוּ לֶ֑קַח Isa 29:24 , they shall learn instruction (|| בִּינָה ); וְיוֺסֶף לֶ֑קַח Prov 1:5 a wise man will hear and will increase (his) learning , so Prov 9:9 . 2. teaching , object, as thing taught, יַעֲרֹף כַּמָּטָר לִקְחִי Deut 32:2 (|| אִמְרָתִי ), Job 11:4 טוֺב נָתַתִּי לָכֶם ׳ ל Prov 4:2 also = teaching-power, persuasiveness , ׳ מֶתֶק שְׂפָתַיִם יוֺסִיף ל Prov 16:21 sweetness of lips increaseth persuasiveness (see מתק ), וְעַל שְׂפָתָיו יוֺסִיף לֶקַח v Prov 16:23 in bad sense, of seductive words of adulteress, ׳ בְּרֹב ל Prov 7:21 (|| בְּחֵלֶק שְׂפָתֶיהָ ).
